text.body:
Input by Péter-Dániel Szántó, 2010 July 7, Oxford
% NB: Tibskrit says — Avalokiteśvaravajrośi (?) — KCDS, p. 41. A palmleaf Sanskrit manuscript belonging to the Potala.
% Title translated into Tibetan as Spyan ras gzigs kyi rdo rje'i smon pa.
% the first twelve folios are:
% ff. 25-26, 30-31, 36-41, 43-44 of Daṇḍin's Kāvyādarśa
[1\recto] \siddham oṃ namo vajrasattvāya ||
candravakraṅgaṇḍāgramanthamanthānasvarasarasikaḥ
mahānandāruṇārāgayogaḥ sahajānandalakṣaṇaṃ ca |
kuliśamakarandaghṛṣṭivaraṭakamaṇisaṃsparśarasaḥ
hā hūṃkāramantraṃ japen mantrī suratākārayogibhiḥ ||
% somewhat garbled as well,
% but abc are paralelled in the Sādhanavidhi ms.
% the ``Vidyādharavinodatantra'' 10\recto
% ought to be thouroughly compared with that text
iti dhāraṇopadeśaḥ || 1 ||
kharapavananibodho 'dhamanavātā+ bhidyate |
adhordhvaṃ śirasi kharaśṛṅgam ājñāgragatiḥ ||
iti māraṇopadeśaḥ || 2 ||
jvalati brahmāṇḍakhaṇḍaṃ tribhuvanabhuvanajvalana-
jvalitajvālāvanīmalayagiriśikharāvātasaṅgaprasaṅgate ||
iti jāraṇopadeśaḥ || 3 ||
nāḍī saṃpīḍyamāne amaramaraṇatyāgāt mūrcchitā skandhaprapātaḥ |
ghūrṇitamanāḥ sahajānandaikanandaḥ ||
iti ((kā))raṇopadeśaḥ || 4 ||
gaganamā[1\verso] + + + ḥ yatibhinolatelesonāyamānaḥ(?) |
haraharitaharalakṣmīsaṃpūrṇapūrṇaśaktiḥ ||
iti prastāraṇopadeśaḥ || 5 ||
kapūrabhraṣṭamākṛṣṭibahuneparakṣimānaḥ |
vidyādharā cinota yantrayantrācerajiḥ |
ardhānelordhvalabhir asakṛmāmāṇaḥ (what???)||
ity āryāvaloki + +varavajroliḥ samāptaḥ |
